items.title: Revision Septorhinoplasty: An Updated Narrative Review of Current Concepts in Evaluation and Surgical Management
items.fact_zh: 综述覆盖7类翻修畸形，主张先重建结构、再精修外形，全文无新原始数据。
items.take_zh: 叙述性综述，作者自己承认缺高质量翻修研究——当操作清单可以，别当证据等级。
items.scene_zh: 翻修别指望一次修到位，先把你塌的那层结构立起来，外形是第二步。
items.fact_en: This narrative review covers seven revision deformity patterns and argues that stable structural reconstruction should precede contour refinement; it reports no new primary data.
items.take_en: A narrative review whose own authors call for higher-quality revision-specific studies: a checklist, not proof of superiority.

items.title: Adverse Outcomes and Complications of Autologous Versus Homologous Costal Cartilage Grafts in Septorhinoplasty: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.fact_zh: 50项研究4482例：自体肋与同种肋并发症无显著差异，总翘曲2.9%、感染1.9%、翻修5.0%。
items.take_zh: 偏倚严重到critical、有小样本效应，选材按可得性和成本，别按并发症差异讲。
items.scene_zh: 取自己的肋还是用库里的肋，并发症没差出来，差的是钱、取材那道口子和你的接受度。
items.fact_en: Across 50 studies and 4482 patients, pooled rates were warping 2.9%, infection 1.9% and revision 5.0%, with no significant difference between autologous, irradiated, Tutoplast and fresh-frozen costal cartilage.
items.take_en: Risk of bias was serious to critical with small-study effects, so graft choice should follow availability and cost rather than claimed safety differences.

items.title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Quality of Life in Patients After Rhinoplasty Using Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROMs): A Systematic Review
items.fact_zh: 28项研究：鼻整形后功能、外观与心理评分方向一致改善，无某术式占优，MCID报告少。
items.take_zh: 设计杂、多数没报MCID，能说的是多数人自觉好转，报不出具体涨几分。
items.scene_zh: 分数能涨多少我不敢打包票，但这类研究里大多数人的鼻子和心情都往好的方向走。
items.fact_en: A 28-study systematic review found consistent improvements across NOSE, SNOT-22, SCHNOS, ROE and FACE-Q after rhinoplasty, with no technique superior and limited MCID reporting.
items.take_en: Uniform direction of effect across heterogeneous designs still does not let you promise a specific score gain.

items.journal: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
items.title: Comparing Deep Plane and Superficial Musculoaponeurotic System Facelifts Using Artificial Intelligence-Based Age Estimation
items.fact_zh: 200例照片经AI测龄：正面仅减2.5–2.8岁，侧面误差16–23岁，两种术式无差异。
items.take_zh: 照片取自公开网站、无随访，AI连侧面都测不准，证明不了哪种拉皮更好。
items.scene_zh: 别拿AI测龄当疗效证据，它侧面看你的脸能差二十岁。
items.fact_en: In 200 photographs, AI estimated only 2.5-2.8 years of apparent age reduction frontally, with 16-23 years mean absolute error in profile, and no difference between deep plane and SMAS.
items.take_en: Web-sourced photos without follow-up: AI age estimation cannot adjudicate which facelift technique works better.

items.title: Predictors of Unplanned Admission After Outpatient Rhytidectomy
items.fact_zh: 129例门诊拉皮16.3%非计划住院，与麻醉574对486分钟、合并术式多、肥胖和高血压相关。
items.take_zh: 单中心回顾129例、四级证据；能用来排台，不能当预测模型，合并项目越多越要留床位。
items.scene_zh: 拉皮加眼睑加脂肪一起做、麻醉五六个小时，当天回家的把握就没那么足，留一晚更稳。
items.fact_en: Of 129 outpatient rhytidectomies, 16.3% required unplanned admission, associated with longer anesthesia (574 vs 486 min), more concurrent procedures, obesity and hypertension.
items.take_en: Level-4 single-center data: usable for scheduling and bed planning, not a validated prediction model.

items.title: Shear-Wave Elastography for Predicting the Occurrence and Assessing the Severity of Capsular Contracture After Implant-Based Breast Augmentation and Reconstruction: A Review of the Evidence
items.fact_zh: 8项研究（每项2–51例）：剪切波弹性成像测包膜硬度随Baker分级升高，阈值未外部验证。
items.take_zh: 样本小、无前瞻预测研究，SWE只能当触诊的补充，不能凭一个kPa数决定手术。
items.scene_zh: 摸着硬不硬还是靠手，超声测硬度只是帮手，没人能拿一个数就让你进手术室。
items.fact_en: Eight reports of 2-51 patients each found periprosthetic stiffness rising with Baker grade, but neither proposed threshold (~52 and 82 kPa) has been externally validated.
items.take_en: No study shows early elastography predicts later contracture; it remains an adjunct to palpation, not a surgical indication.
